summary: Prevents Ibis from completing a package transaction scope. Inside a registered scope on an ownership dialect, protected_call() temporarily swaps the Ibis backend's driver handle for a _NonOwningDriver view whose commit/rollback/transaction are no-ops (SQLite and PostgreSQL only; DuckDB needs no swap). Any exception escaping a protected call poisons the scope, and calls into a poisoned scope are rejected. real_driver_handle() unwraps the view.
extension_points: _COMPLETING_IBIS_BACKENDS lists Ibis backends that complete transactions internally
lifecycle_notes: Swap is restored in finally; nested protected calls do not double-wrap
documentation_hooks: Why Ibis's internal commits would otherwise end a caller's unit of work
risks: No unit test imports this module directly; coverage is indirect through transaction scope tests
Depends on Ibis internals (driver attribute name and internal commit paths) that may change across Ibis releases
